sources.title: Quatrième Communication Nationale de la Côte d’Ivoire au titre de la CCNUCC
sources.organization: Ministère de l’Environnement, du Développement Durable et de la Transition Écologique, Côte d’Ivoire
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical water event in 2018; country and sector observations; RCP projections through 2050 and 2099.
sources.methodology: National assessment using sector vulnerability matrices, historical cases and RCP climate projections.
sources.limitations: Water and conflict examples partly cite earlier sources; conflict risk is analytical, not causal.

sources.title: Project to Strengthen the Resilience of Local Communities in the Bafing Region Made Vulnerable due to Farmer-Breeder Conflicts Exacerbated by Climate Change: Fully Developed Proposal
sources.organization: Interprofessional Fund for Agricultural Research and Advice (FIRCA) and Bafing Regional Council; submitted to the Adaptation Fund
sources.temporal_coverage: Regional climate and livelihood context; four-year locally led adaptation project approved in 2025.
sources.methodology: FIRCA's Adaptation Fund proposal with local context diagnostics and community consultations.
sources.limitations: Historical local inputs are cited; proposed outputs are not evaluations.

sources.title: Northern Côte d’Ivoire Crisis Response Plan 2024
sources.organization: International Organization for Migration (IOM) Côte d’Ivoire
sources.temporal_coverage: 2024 response-plan context and proposed activities; funding page updated 2026-02-05.
sources.methodology: IOM response plan combines regional context analysis, planned interventions, target estimates and funding requirements.
sources.limitations: Contextual pathways cite earlier studies; planned activities are not evaluated outcomes.

claims.locator: PDF pp. 180-181; printed pp. 158-159, Table 33 and discussion
claims.paraphrase: Government links rising temperature and falling rainfall to arable-land loss and greater land-conflict risk; its matrix also names farmer/herder shares, youth, population growth and migration as vulnerability factors.
claims.scenario: RCP 4.5 and RCP 8.5 through 2050; the table labels land-conflict occurrence as increasing but gives no conflict estimate.
claims.limitations: National analytical matrix, not subnational conflict measurement or causal attribution.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: Report says temperature rise and rainfall decline affect land availability and farm density, favoring land conflict; projected occurrence rises.

claims.locator: PDF pp. 184-185; printed pp. 162-163, water-resources vulnerability discussion
claims.paraphrase: Lower rainfall reduced Bouaké's Loka reservoir (70% of city supply) in 2018; three weeks without piped water prompted emergency tankers and temporary migration. Northern shortages also constrained agriculture.
claims.limitations: The communication cites WFP 2019 and Sanogo and Esnault 2018; it gives no household count.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: Reduced rainfall lowered Loka's level; the resulting outage accompanied temporary migration.

claims.locator: PDF pp. 5, 8 and 11, Bafing climate, livelihoods and transhumance context
claims.paraphrase: Proposal describes dry-season water and pasture scarcity; transhumant and local herds use residual water and crop areas, with crop damage and recurrent farmer-herder conflict across Koro, Touba and Ouaninou affecting social cohesion.
claims.limitations: Proposal draws on cited local studies and consultations; no independent conflict evaluation.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: Proposal links long dry seasons and rainfall disruption to pasture/water scarcity, resource competition, farmer-herder conflict and cohesion impacts.

claims.locator: PDF p. 9, community gender analysis and resource access
claims.paraphrase: Community consultations report women usually access land through husbands and lack land ownership; distance to perennial water limits dry-season access, while herders rely on surface water.
claims.limitations: Proposal's consultations are not a representative household survey.

claims.locator: PDF pp. 15-18, proposed pastoral adaptation and project activities
claims.paraphrase: Approved proposal plans water/fodder pastoral areas and community parks to reduce herd wandering and crop damage; it also supports local conflict-management mechanisms, climate-data use, and women/youth livelihood diversification.
claims.limitations: Approved project design, not verified delivery or outcomes.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: Proposal says planned infrastructure should reduce wandering and crop destruction while conflict mechanisms support peaceful coexistence.

claims.locator: PDF p. 4, context analysis; p. 13, adaptation and disaster risk reduction
claims.paraphrase: IOM describes northern farmer-herder competition over pasture and water; it says climate effects on agriculture push rural mobility and aggravate existing tensions and social-cohesion risks.
claims.limitations: Context analysis cites perception surveys and prior studies; it does not estimate climate attribution.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: Plan says climate effects on farming aggravate resource competition, intergroup tensions and mobility pressures.

claims.locator: PDF pp. 4-6 and 13, insecurity context and planned adaptation response
claims.paraphrase: Insecurity raises concerns about remote and cross-border travel; livestock-border restrictions made transhumant movements harder and weakened exchanges among herders, hosts and authorities. IOM proposes local adaptation capacity, community risk assessments, resilient infrastructure and flood early warning.
claims.limitations: Plan does not test whether insecurity reduced climate-program delivery; proposed activities are unevaluated.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: IOM says insecurity-linked border measures made transhumance harder and weakened exchanges among herders, hosts and local authorities.

access_audit.notes: Opened the complete 271-page official French communication; reviewed land-conflict table and water-scarcity episode.
Downloaded the complete 140-page proposal from the Adaptation Fund's linked official attachment; web preview could not parse its application/octet-stream response.
Downloaded and reviewed the complete 15-page IOM plan; web preview returned 403, so no search excerpt was used as evidence.

search_audit.query: Côte d'Ivoire named regional climate vulnerability drought water conflict districts report
search_audit.outcome: The official national communication gives a Bouaké water outage and northern water scarcity; the Bafing proposal details regional agro-pastoral vulnerability and resource access.

search_audit.query: Côte d'Ivoire climate change farmer herder conflict water pasture land primary Bafing proposal
search_audit.outcome: The government communication describes projected national land-conflict risk; the Bafing proposal explicitly links dry-season resource scarcity, transhumance and farmer-herder tensions.

search_audit.query: Côte d'Ivoire insecurity border restrictions movement climate adaptation capacity local actors IOM response plan
search_audit.outcome: The IOM plan states insecurity-linked border measures made transhumance harder and weakened exchange spaces; it does not test resulting effects on climate-program delivery.

search_audit.query: Côte d'Ivoire Bafing resilience peace coexistence pastoral infrastructure conflict management adaptation proposal IOM DRR
search_audit.outcome: The approved Bafing design proposes pastoral infrastructure and conflict mechanisms; IOM plans local DRR/adaptation capacity, risk assessments and flood warnings. Outcomes are not evaluated.

gaps: The Bafing proposal and IOM plan describe design and intended outcomes, not independently verified adaptation or peace impacts.
The national land-conflict matrix is analytical and does not estimate causal contribution or disaggregate risk to subnational locations.
The national communication's Bouaké water/migration example cites WFP 2019 and Sanogo and Esnault 2018; household counts are not given.
IOM documents border insecurity and weakened exchange spaces but does not measure effects on climate-adaptation delivery.
